translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Ikamantakari Juan omitsitsiyaatantaneri
Ikanta Herodes jitachari Tetrarca, ikemakotakeri Jesús.
Ikantziri rimperatanewo: “Jirika Jesús iriitake Juan omitsitsiyaatantaneri. Iri añagaatsi, piñeeri otzimi ishintsinka.”
Tema iri Herodes aakaantakeriri ketziroini Juan, roosotakaantakeri, romonkyaakaantakeri. Iro kantakaantzirori Herodías iinantawetari irirentzi Felipe.
Tema ikaminaawetatyaari Juan jirika Herodes, ikantawetari: “Te okameethatzi paapithatantziro.”

Ari ikowawetaka ritsitokakaanterime, iro kantzimaitacha osheki pinkathatakeriri Juan, riyotaiyini Kamantantaneri rini. Ithaawantanakari Herodes atziripaini, ikantashiretzi: “Arika nitsitokakaantakeri, ari inkisaneentaitakena.”

Okanta imonkaataka kiteesheri roimoshirenkawentawo itzimantari Herodes. Ipiyotaiyakani osheki isheninka, roimoshirenkaiyani. Ari ipokapaake ishinto Herodías, omampaapaaka. Okameethatzimotanakeri Herodes.
Ikantakero: “Oitarika pinkowakotenari, ari nompakemiro. Imaperotatya, riyotzi Pawa eero namatawitzimi.”
Okantakero onaanate: “Pinkanteri rithatzinkakaanteri Juan.” Irojatzi okantantanakariri: “Nokowi pamakotakenawo iito Juan pasoshetaki.”
Ari rowashiretanaka Herodes, te ikowaweta. Iro kantzimaitacha ikemaiyakerini isheninka ikantakerori ketziroini.
Irootake rithatzinkakaantantakariri Juan.
Ramakoitakero iito, ipakoitakero aanakeniro onaanate.
Irojatzi ripokaiyantapaarini riyotaanewo Juan, ikitatairi. Jataiyanakeni risaikira Jesús, ikamantapaakeri.
Rowakaari Jesús 5000 shiramparipaini
Ikanta ikemake Jesús kamake Juan, otetanaka pitotsiki riyaatero tonkaariiteki. Iro kantzimaitacha ikemakoitakeri tsika riyaate, shiyaiyanakani ikenaiyanakeni awotsiki, royaataitanakeri.
Iro raatakotapaakitziini Jesús, iñaapaatziiri osheki ipiyotaka atziri. Retakoshiretapaakari, retsiyatakotakaake osheki mantsiyayetatsiri.
Okanta otsireniityaanake, ikantzi riyotaanewo Jesús: “Pamine, asaikatzi tonkaariki, tsireniityaanake. Pinkaatero pikenkithatzi, riyaataita atziri nampitsiki rowapaiya.”
Rakanakeri, ikantziri: “¿Iitaka ratsipetantyaawori riyaayetai? Pimperi eeroka rowanawo.”
Ikantanake riyotaanewo: “Tekaatsi nomperiri naaka. Apatziro otzimi 5 pan eejatzi apite shima.”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Pamakenari jaka.”

Ikantakeri maawoini atziri: “Pisaikaiyeni.” Saikaiyanakeni atziripaini. Raakero pan, eejatzi shima, aminanake jenoki inkiteki, ramananaka, ikantzi: “Niwethareemi Ashitanarí, eerokatake pakenawori jiroka nowanawo.” Itzipetowakero, ipayetakeri riyotaanewo, rowawisaakeniri atziripaini piyotainchari.
Maawoini rowaiyakani, kemakitaiyakani. Ipiyotairo tzimagaantapaintsiri, roteyetairo kantziriki, okaatzi 12 yeekitatsiri.
Aamaaka ikaatzi 5000 shirampari owainchari. Eenitatsi tsinane eejatzi eentsipaini owainchari.
Ranashaatantawo Jesús inkaare
Ikantairi Jesús riyotaanewo: “Jame petaiyaawo intatsikero.” Ikantakeri eejatzi piyotainchari atziripaini: “Kantacha piyaataiyaini.”
Irojatzi ikenantanakari irirori tonkaariki, ramanamanaatari Ashitariri. Okanta otsirenitanake, saikake apaniroini Jesús janta.
Weyaakotaiyaani riyotaanewo niyankyaaneki, antawo otamakaare inkaare, oipiyapiyatakotakeri tampyaa.
Okanta okiteeshetzimatake, pokai Jesús ranashaatantaawo inkaare.
Te riyotawairi, thaawaiyanakeni riyotaanewo, ikaimaiyanakeni: “¡Kaakitake shiretsiwé!”
Riñaanatapairi irirori, ikantziri: “Naaka pokaatsi, tontashire pinkantya eero pithaawawaitzi.”
Ari ikantanake Pedro: “Eerokama Nowinkatharité, pimatakainawo nanashaatantyaawo naaka inkaare.”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Pipokanakeeta.” Anashitanaka Pedro inkaareki riyaatashitanakeri ikatziyakaga.
Ari ikenkithashiretanaka Pedro antawo otamakaare inkaare, thaawanake, irootake ritsitsiyantanakari, ikaimanake: “Pinkatharí paawaina.”
Rakothatashitanakeri Jesús, raawairi. Irojatzi ikantantanakariri: “Eepichokiini pikemisantakena. ¿Oitaka pikisoshiretantari?”
Ikanta rotetapaa pitotsiki, awisainkatanake tampyaa.
Antawoite ipinkathatanakeri riyotaanewo, ikantaiyanakerini: “Imaperotatya eerokatake Itomi Pawa.”
Retsiyatakotakaantake Jesús Genesaret-ki
Ikanta rareetaiyaani intatsikero nampitsiki Genesaret.
Iro raatakotapaakitziini Jesús, riyotaitawakeri. Ikamantaitakeri maawoini nampitawori janta, ramayetapaakeri mantsiyayetatsiri.
Ikantaitakeri Jesús: “Pishineteri mantsiyari riterotawakero piithaare, retsiyatakotantaiyaari.” Ari okantzimaitaka, ikaatzi terotzitakeriri iithaare, etsiyatakoyetai.

footnotes.text: Kantakotachari jaka: “Okanta okiteeshetzimatake”, irootake oshiyawori rametari rantayetapiintziro owayeripaini raamaawenta tsireniriki, eero ikakiwaitanta apaani owayeri maawoini tsireniriki, ontzimatye intzime 4 owayeri aamaawentachane. Apaani etanakyaawone owakera ontsirenitanake, itsipa arika oniyankiityaanake tsireniri, itsipa arika oniyankitake tsireniri, weyaantapaakyaawone iri kiteeshetakotatsine.
